title: A claim made through the kb MCP tool posts the backlog-claim intent and returns the overlaps the Bash hook would print
goal: backlog_claim posts the same intent a Bash backlog.py claim posts through the coord hook (topic backlog-claim, the item, its item file's touches, the session) before it runs the command, and its structuredContent holds overlaps: the digest lines of other live sessions' intents and held claims that meet the item's touches (empty when none), so the notice kb/_self/backlog.md says the tool path skips reaches the agent in the result; with no coord store reachable the claim still runs and overlaps is empty (the policy is fail open for announcements)

run: import sys,os,subprocess,tempfile,json;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");os.environ["KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS"]="1";[os.environ.pop(k,None) for k in ("CLAUDECODE","CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION")];R=os.getcwd();E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=tempfile.mkdtemp()+"/c.sqlite");os.environ["KB_COORD_STORE"]=E["KB_COORD_STORE"];import kb_mcp;a=tempfile.mkdtemp();g=lambda *x:subprocess.run(["git","-C",a,*x],check=True,capture_output=True);g("init","-q");g("config","user.email","a@example.com");g("config","user.name","n");iid=subprocess.run([sys.executable,R+"/_tools/backlog.py","--root",a,"new","story","--title","Planted","--goal","g","--touch","x/*","--check","true"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split()[2];g("add","-A");g("commit","-qm","plant");co=lambda *x:subprocess.run([sys.executable,R+"/_tools/coord.py",*x],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E);co("claim","session/other","--ttl","600","--holder","other");co("post","--kind","intent","--field","session=other","--field","touch=x/*");os.chdir(a);r=kb_mcp.handle({"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"backlog_claim","arguments":{"id":iid,"by":"worker"}}})["result"];s=r["structuredContent"];assert s["overlaps"],("no overlap line",s);ev=co("wait","--since","0","--timeout","0","--kind","intent").stdout;assert "backlog-claim" in ev and iid in ev,("no claim intent",ev[-300:])
